name: OpenFIGI API (Bloomberg-operated FIGI mapping)
access: HTTPS POST to api.openfigi.com/v3/mapping (JSON jobs); API key optional (X-OPENFIGI-APIKEY header, from ~/.unknown/config/data.json openfigi_api_key)
cost_model: Free; an optional free API key raises limits

rate_limit.source: https://www.openfigi.com/api/documentation (CAP-DATA-04): mapping 25 requests per 60 s and 10 jobs per request without a key; 250 per 60 s and 100 jobs with a key; search/filter 5 or 20 per 60 s. Enforced with a strict sliding window; 429 waits for retry-after; 413 splits the batch.

failure_behavior: 429: wait the retry-after seconds, then retry (bounded). 413: split the batch. Other errors: the run fails; existing mappings stay; new inputs remain unmapped (never guessed). Inputs failing check-digit or format validation are rejected before any request; CUSIP/SEDOL inputs are refused without a recorded licence (CAP-INS-03).

datasets.description: Per-job FIGI mapping outcomes (figi, compositeFIGI, shareClassFIGI, name, ticker, exchCode, marketSector, securityType), including 'no match' outcomes
datasets.coverage: Instruments known to OpenFIGI; listed equities by default (includeUnlistedEquities adds unlisted and delisted)
datasets.history_depth: Current mappings only; no historical ticker endpoint found (CAP-DATA-04)
datasets.availability_rule: Available at receipt time of the response that carried it; an identical later response writes nothing; a different outcome is a new publication at its own receipt time.
datasets.rights_source: https://www.openfigi.com/docs/terms-of-service: FIGI identifiers dedicated to the public domain, 'freely reproduced, distributed, transmitted, used, modified, built upon'; descriptions provided AS IS; FIGI/OPENFIGI marks only for fair use. Redistribution not asserted here (not needed).
datasets.rights_status: recorded from the capability register (CAP-DATA-04, CAP-INS-02)
